integrity: Mathematical assertions derive from an analytic proof with supplementary finite numerical checks; earlier Gaussian KL identities, isotropic Lanczos covariance construction, and nonsharp condition-number bounds are credited. Bibliographic coverage is not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Finite real SPD precision matrices and exact trace-matched isotropic covariance; directed Gaussian KL from isotropic approximation to exact inverse covariance. Numerical estimates of the trace, non-Gaussian models, nontrivial bulk cross couplings, finite-precision Lanczos and end-to-end convergence are not included.
title: Sharp condition-number KL envelope for trace-matched Gaussian inverse covariance
